item.title: Take the Long Way Home
item.description:
(Written while listening to Supertramp)

I looked over at my Romeo. How about we make a picture show? Let’s take the long way home. A corona-free drive home.

We’ll have some times when we feel we’re part of the scenery.

item.title: Drive out to the Farm
item.description:
Jeff and I decided to take a drive out to the farm.

Along the way, we saw some beautiful red rocks.

And a pretty college campus.

item.title: The bridge to totality (eclipse)
item.description: Woo hooo, the August 21, 2017 total eclipse went right through our town. We walked from Dad’s house to the Platte River bridge on Dark Island Trail to experience totality. OMG IT WAS AMAZING.
